records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Franco has repainted the awning and did NOT tell anyone he was going to, so half the
block walked past the shop this morning looking for a tailor that has been there for
nineteen years.

It is green now. It was green before. It is a different green.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-01.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
He says it is "sage." Franco. Sage.

I have been informed by his wife that it is the same paint.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-02.md

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Family meal tonight was the trim off forty ducks, a bag of rice, and whatever was
about to turn. Fed fourteen people. I would put it against anything that left that
kitchen on a plate tonight.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-01.md

records.author: char.noah
records.text:
The correct number of browser tabs is the number you would be willing to have
printed out and handed to you.

Most people are running a small book.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/noah-01.md

records.author: char.noah
records.text:
And before anyone sends me their tab manager: a tool that makes a bad system
survivable is the reason the bad system survives.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/noah-02.md

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
There is a man at McGolrick who makes a hot sauce I cannot crack. He will tell you
the pepper. He will not tell you the smoky sweet thing underneath. Three
years of asking. Three years of "family recipe" and that face he makes.

I will get it out of him. I have nothing but time and no pride.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-02.md

and before anyone says "facade inspection" i KNOW about facade inspection, i have

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Dropped the autumn candles at Marcus's and stayed forty minutes, which is what
happens when you go to Marcus's.

Everything that happens on Bedford happens in that shop first and roughly nine days
before anyone else hears about it.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-03.md

records.text:
third call. a woman named Patrice has told me to stop calling, which i respect, and
which i am choosing to read as a data point

it was a sidewalk shed permit. it was always a sidewalk shed permit. patrice was

anyway

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
The key is building layers of flavour — you cannot rush caramelisation and you cannot
fake it. Onions go sweet at their own pace and every shortcut you have read about is
someone describing a different, worse dish.

Twenty-five minutes. Low. Stir more than you want to.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-03.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
twenty-five minutes!!! @emmacooks I have been making them for nine and calling it
dinner
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-04.md

records.author: char.oliver
records.text: It has been eighteen years. Not nineteen.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/oliver-01.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Met a dog outside the coffee place today who is called Brisket and who has a
LinkedIn, allegedly, per his owner, who would not elaborate and then left.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-05.md

records.author: char.noah
records.text:
That is a beautiful piece of hardware.

Which is to say the weight distribution is correct and the thermals are honest.
There is no design decision in it that is only decoration, and that is why it looks
like that.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/noah-03.md

records.author: char.elijah
records.text:
Every coffee place on this stretch has raised prices by the same amount in the same
fortnight and all of them will tell you it was the beans.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/elijah-02.md

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Sixtieth birthday for twenty-two people yesterday. Nine hours, one oven, a kitchen
with a single working burner and a host who kept opening the oven to look.

I will not be disclosing the rate.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-04.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Maria's daughter is getting married in April and Maria has already chosen the
flowers, the backup flowers in case the first are wrong, and the rehearsal
flowers, which I did not know was a category.

I love her. I will be exactly this bad when it is my turn to have opinions about
someone else's day.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-06.md

records.author: char.jasper
records.text:
there is a man on eighth who sells one kind of sandwich and will not tell you what
is in it and i think that is the correct way to run a business
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/jasper-07.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Someone asked me a genuinely serious question at the coffee place today and I
handled it beautifully for about nine seconds.

Speaking of disasters — did I tell you what happened to the man who bought the
laundromat?
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-07.md

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Long one tonight.

Everything I made today was somebody else's idea.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-05.md

records.author: char.elijah
records.text: Nine seconds is longer than most people manage.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/elijah-03.md

records.author: char.noah
records.text:
Switched back. Six weeks of the other one and I have no data supporting the change,
which is the only honest reason to reverse a decision.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/noah-04.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
The bakery has put pumpkin things in the window and it is the fourteenth of
September, which I consider an act of aggression.

I bought two.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-08.md

records.author: char.oliver
records.text:
The corner lot has been empty for eleven years. Someone is paying to keep it that
way.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/oliver-02.md

records.text: he says four words a month and they are the correct four @ollie-oxen-free
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-09.md

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Back at McGolrick. Bought tomatoes for six people and I am one person.

This keeps happening and I have decided to stop calling it a mistake and start
calling it a personality trait.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-06.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Marcus has started carrying a hot sauce from somewhere upstate and would not stop
talking about the label, which is beautiful, and which is doing a great deal of work
for a sauce that tastes like a candle.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-10.md

reorganised the records again. chronological was a mistake. it is now by how i feel
about them which is unsearchable and correct

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Taking on private lessons this autumn. Knife skills, braising, how to read a recipe
and then ignore it correctly.

You do not need better equipment. You need to stand closer to the pan and stop
apologising to it.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-07.md

records.author: char.elijah
records.text:
Drove past a place upstate with a barn on it and about nine acres and I did the
arithmetic on it in my head before I had finished passing it.

Anyway.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/elijah-04.md

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Franco fixed a hem for me in eleven minutes while telling me about his nephew's
lease, which he should not have told me, and which I will now be thinking about for
a week.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/olivia-11.md

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Delicata are in and they are the one squash you do not have to peel, which makes
them the only honest squash.

Roast them in rounds, high heat, until the edges go dark. That is the recipe. That
is the whole recipe.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/emma-08.md

records.author: char.jasper
records.text: someone asked what my people do at thanksgiving and i have decided to go outside
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/jasper-10.md

records.author: char.noah
records.text:
The building's package situation is not a fixable problem. There is no system that
survives forty people who each believe they are the exception.

Moving on.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/noah-05.md

Dinner at Emma's on Sunday. I have been instructed not to bring anything.

I will be bringing something.

I have been told the tarte tatin has a fifty per cent failure rate and I intend to

Cooking for my people on Sunday. The menu has been living in my head for days and

Soup. Something with brown butter. A tarte tatin that will either work or be a
story.

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
For the record, it survived.

The hard part is not the caramel. The hard part is the flip: plate on top, one breath, turn it over like you meant it, and do not lift the pan to check halfway.

went to the wine place and asked the guy which bottle says "i am taking this seriously" and he handed me one without looking up

$19. seriousness is $19

records.author: char.olivia
records.text:
Still in possession of a box of candle lids that fit a jar I do not own. Called the man again this morning.

He says my jars are "standard" and his lids are "standard" and he would like me to know he has been doing this for thirty years. We are now friends. The lids still don't fit.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/2026-10-05-olivia-01.md

records.text: This is how you end up with a quinoa salad.

records.text:
An appetizer is a latency problem. The job is to cover the gap between arrival and dinner without consuming capacity dinner needs.

Anything you have to cook is scope creep.

records.text: spent an hour at the gilded fern not eating, which marcus took personally, talking to four different people about nothing in particular. this is a skill. it is not on my résumé.

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Lesson today. My student asked to learn something new, so we did a pan sauce, and at the door she asked if next week we could do the chicken again.

We can always do the chicken again. Nobody has ever been sorry they know one dish very well.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/2026-10-07-emma-01.md

records.text: the chicken again is a love language and you know it @emmacooks

records.author: char.emma
records.text:
Dessert is mine on Sunday. Three very good shops this afternoon, one very clever idea in each of them, and I left all three ideas on the shelf.

Sunday will be something I already know how to do.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/posts/2026-10-09-emma-01.md

Paid thirty dollars for a cheese. Before anyone asks: the fat content is correct for a red served too warm, which is a known failure mode at these dinners.

It is a mitigation.

records.title: The Missing Hot Sauce
records.primaryEvent: Open on the empty stall and Dorothy's 'just in case' bottle — the loss that makes the mystery personal, and the theme that a community protects its own.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m1_01_the_missing_hot_sauce.md

records.title: The First Supper
records.primaryEvent: Serve the soup — the group tastes what's at stake, and Hank's disappearance stops being Emma's alone.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m1_02_the_first_supper.md

records.title: A Simmering Suspicion
records.primaryEvent: Marcus's 'man running from something' is the catalyst — it turns dinner-party curiosity into a real question.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m1_03_a_simmering_suspicion.md

records.title: Stirring the Pot
records.primaryEvent: The theory competition — every character's frame is characterization and misdirection; Emma's joke is the truth no one takes seriously.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m1_04_stirring_the_pot.md

records.title: Mise en Place
records.primaryEvent: The club commits to investigating and reconvening with a potluck — assignments drawn — turning a dinner into a case.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m1_05_mise_en_place.md

records.title: A Fine Sieve
records.primaryEvent: Oliver's methodical library dig turns idle theory into a documented lead — the case breaks into Act 2.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m2_06_a_fine_sieve.md

records.title: Gathering the Ingredients
records.primaryEvent: Olivia works Marcus for texture and pulls the LLC out of Oliver at home — surfacing what he'd keep to himself.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m2_07_gathering_the_ingredients.md

records.title: The Bottom Line
records.primaryEvent: Elijah quietly makes the LLC the group's problem and starts modeling the money — the case gains a spine.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m2_08_the_bottom_line.md

records.title: A Pinch Too Much
records.primaryEvent: Noah converts the analog dead-end into a data trail — the shell stack hits a wall, and he goes looking for what it has filed.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m2_09_a_pinch_too_much.md

records.title: Loose Lips
records.primaryEvent: Jasper's need to contribute causes the breach — the call that quietly turns the developer's attention on the group.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m2_10_loose_lips.md

records.title: The Empty Stall
records.primaryEvent: The empty Saturday stall plus the Paolo precedent turn one disappearance into a pattern — someone is doing this on purpose.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m2_11_the_empty_stall.md

records.title: Coming to a Boil
records.primaryEvent: The potluck 'solves' the case — false victory — while the seeds of the reversal (Dorothy's brisk stranger, Jasper's unseen warning) sit in plain sight.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m2_12_coming_to_a_boil.md

records.title: Service for One
records.primaryEvent: Bring the threat home and put a face on it. The pressure is economic and personal, not an exposed secret. Pike reveals himself with a charm that reads as menace.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m3_13_service_for_one.md

records.title: The Seamless Supper
records.primaryEvent: Emergency dinner rallies the group around the C&D; privately, Emma finally lets Olivia see how precarious things really are.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m3_14_the_seamless_supper.md

records.title: A Bitter Taste
records.beat: All Is Lost (part 2) / Dark Night of the Soul
records.primaryEvent: Noah traces the breach to Jasper; the group's sharpest fight — then Oliver stands up and turns despair into a plan.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m3_15_a_bitter_taste.md

records.title: The Recipe for Revenge
records.primaryEvent: The swarm plan and roles come together; Jasper quietly takes the find-Hank mission.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m3_16_the_recipe_for_revenge.md

records.title: Sharpening the Knives
records.primaryEvent: Alone-but-connected, each member builds their piece of the campaign; Jasper quietly pockets Dorothy's bottle for the road.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m3_17_sharpening_the_knives.md

records.title: Turning Up the Heat
records.primaryEvent: The coordinated campaign launches and hope builds — the club acts as one team instead of six investigators.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_18_turning_up_the_heat.md

records.title: The Ridgeline Diner
records.primaryEvent: From the road: Jasper's first night of dead-end calls — he keeps going anyway; the loneliness under the performance surfaces alone.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_19_the_diner.md

records.title: Ghost Kitchen
records.primaryEvent: The counterattack lands — a glib commentator, blog takedowns, and a close call with a traced account leave the group doubting they've made things worse.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_20_ghost_kitchen.md

records.title: The Starlite Drive-In
records.primaryEvent: From the road: Noah's pruned spreadsheet narrows the search and a seed supplier confirms the collective is real, growing Fish Peppers, named 'meadow-something' — the rumor Jasper carried out of Brooklyn finally firms up.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_21_the_drive_in.md

records.title: Murph's
records.beat: Finale (from the road — the low point)
records.primaryEvent: From the road: the low point — Jasper nearly drives home, then a bartender names Meadowlight; Murph's cousin starts the vouch-in, and the door cracks open.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_22_the_dive.md

records.title: Farm to Table
records.primaryEvent: Jasper finds Hank in the Meadowlight greenhouse and shows him the bottle — his quiet, un-performed redemption, and Hank agrees to come home.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_23_farm_to_table.md

records.title: The Proof
records.primaryEvent: Oliver's sourced rebuttal — patent-troll economics, the Paolo precedent, and the ghost-kitchen evidence — arms a hundred small voices; a food critic adopts the framing, sentiment flips, investors pull, and the patent claims fall (the C&D withdrawal follows off-page, Fri Oct 23).
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_24_the_proof.md

records.title: Family Meal
records.primaryEvent: Family Meal — Hank returns with Jasper, the bottle's arc closes, the economic squeeze lifts, and the club commits to continuing with rotating hosts.
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/chapters/m4_25_family_meal.md

records.subject: char.elijah
records.state:
The first of the month went home, like every month, before anything else counted as
his. A report came back with a senior name on work he did; he documented it and said
nothing. Every coffee place on this stretch went up by the same amount in the same
fortnight. He drove past nine acres upstate with a barn on it, did the arithmetic
before he had finished passing it, and told himself it was idle. Sunday is Emma's,
and the tarte tatin may or may not work. He intends to be there for either outcome.
carrying: the monthly transfer home, which is not spendable money
a report with someone else's name on it
nine acres and a barn, done in his head
Sunday: the tarte tatin, either outcome
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/stretches/elijah/2026-10-02.md

records.subject: char.emma
records.state:
Two months ago she was still on the line, feeding fourteen people off duck trim and
calling it the best food in the building. Then the coq au vin: two weeks of
complaints, the apron handed back, twelve good hours, and the panic. Three weeks out,
the work is catering at a rate she won't say out loud, lessons she advertises like a
sure thing, and buying tomatoes for six. Sunday is the one kitchen that doesn't feel
like a verdict. She has told herself leaving was brave. Most days she believes it.
carrying: savings that go down and not up
whether walking out was worth it
Sunday's menu, revised four times on receipts
three years of asking about the man at McGolrick's hot sauce
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/stretches/emma/2026-10-02.md

records.subject: char.jasper
records.state:
August was the scaffolding. Five days, three calls, a woman named Patrice telling him
to stop, and it was a sidewalk shed permit the whole time. He apologised. He posted
"anyway." His theories are usually wrong, and he has made that part of the act, which
mostly works. September was quieter: 311 queues that refill faster than he can close
them, the records sorted into nineteen feelings. Someone asked about Thanksgiving and
he went outside. He knows he's the entertainment. He doesn't mind. Mostly.
carrying: Patrice's patience, spent once already
a holiday question he didn't answer
nineteen index cards
Sunday: one (1) thing, and it isn't food
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/stretches/jasper/2026-10-02.md

records.subject: char.noah
records.state:
Work has a dashboard that marks a delivery resolved when the driver reaches the wrong
door, and he defended that shortcut in a meeting. Now he reads the tickets. The
colleague on support who sends them is usually right, which he respects and does not
enjoy. The takes at home are going well: tabs, tools that keep bad systems alive, a
piece of hardware he called beautiful and then justified. The building's packages are
unfixable, so he has stopped thinking about them. Sunday is Emma's.
carrying: the exception path he wants in the next release
the tickets his tidy metric swallowed
Elijah's reply that the bad system is load-bearing, unanswered
Sunday: actual dinner, as distinct from stated dinner
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/stretches/noah/2026-10-02.md

records.subject: char.oliver
records.state:
A parcel-history question at work that should have taken an hour took three days,
because two city records give the same lot two addresses. He found it. Nobody
noticed, which is how the work is meant to go. The corner lot has been empty for
eleven years; he said so once, in public, and not again. He corrected Olivia about
Franco's shop, eighteen years, not nineteen, sixteen days after she posted it. The
landlord email is on its fourth draft. Sunday is Emma's. He will listen.
carrying: the corner lot, eleven years empty, and whoever pays to keep it that way
two city records with two addresses for one lot
the landlord email about the sticking window, fourth draft
Sunday: listening
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/stretches/oliver/2026-10-02.md

records.subject: char.olivia
records.state:
Franco's awning, Marcus's shop, a dog called Brisket with a LinkedIn: a summer of the
block's small stories, most of which she heard first. The candles are a small run for
Marcus's shelf, and he wants an invoice before he gives them more room, which is fair
and slightly wounding. Someone asked her something serious in September; she's decided
nine seconds counts as handling it. Oliver has said about four words a month, the
correct four. Sunday is Emma's, and she has been told not to bring anything.
carrying: Franco's nephew's lease, which she should not have been told
Marcus wanting an invoice before more shelf space, and a box of lids in the wrong size
a serious question she turned into a laundromat story
Sunday: told not to bring anything
records.sourceFile: stories/01. The Case of the Missing Hot Sauce/stretches/olivia/2026-10-02.md

records.subject: char.garrett-pike
records.oneLine: Garrett Pike is not a cartoon villain. He's a mid-forties hospitality entrepreneur who genuinely believes he's revitalizing neglected neighborhoods. He sees himself as a builder — someone who creates beautiful spaces, employs local workers, and brings economic energy to places that were stagnating. The fact that he displaces the people who made those neighborhoods worth investing in is, to him, an unfortunate externality. Collateral damage in the service of progress.
records.sourceFile: codex/antagonists/book1_garrett_pike.md

records.subject: char.hank
records.oneLine: A charismatic hot sauce artisan and storyteller whose family recipe and theatrical personality make him a beloved fixture of the McGolrick Park farmers market — and the central figure of the group's first mystery.

records.subject: char.dorothy
